is: The bottom domain crate: the vocabulary every other domain crate speaks — the DID, the text primitives, the maturity posture, the blob and markdown stubs, the one clock type and the string-validation builder — with no I/O and no workspace dependency (shared allowed).
conventions: Depends on no other domain crate; every other domain crate may depend on it. Doc links up a layer are plain code text.
Every element mirrors a design glossary page (`entities/` in the corpus); the page pointer lives in this node's `refs`, never in a doc comment.
Stub modules are allowed, and documented honestly as stubs.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.
Each file owns its id type, value objects, and pure invariant logic.
`Did` is the one id here that derives serde; the CLI identity file needs it.
`Did` derives `From`/`AsRef`/`Display`, with no `Deref` and no `new` wrapper; its `FromStr` is hand-written, the one untrusted door. Every error type is a `thiserror` derive.

Enum vocabularies derive strum (Display, EnumString, IntoStaticStr, VariantArray; serialize_all = snake_case), keep their typed Unknown* parse errors through parse_err_ty/parse_err_fn, and pin their literal token list in the sibling tests.rs; no hand-written ALL consts or as_str tables.

fs.name: src/string_builder/
fs.role: split of string_builder.rs; no information beyond its façade

fs.name: src/string_builder/unicode.rs
fs.role: the public print-safety tables: FORMAT_CHARACTERS (Cf) and DEFAULT_IGNORABLE from UCD 16.0.0, copied from atta (atta depends on no workspace crate) and pinned equal over every char by application/tests/den_names.rs; is_format, is_default_ignorable, is_bidi_control (the nine explicit bidi formatting characters, U+202A–U+202E and U+2066–U+2069; StringBuilder::no_bidi_control reports them as ControlCharacter, as StringBuilder::no_line_separator does U+2028 and U+2029) and is_unsafe_to_print (Cc ∪ Cf ∪ Default_Ignorable ∪ U+2028 ∪ U+2029), for a printer that escapes stored text

notes: Persisted enums (`MaturityRating`) own their storage tokens: renaming one is a migration, and an unknown token is always an error, never a silent default.
See also: the design corpus glossary — `entities/` in ZurNetwork/zurfur-design, indexed by `docs/design-index.md`.
